observation.command:
echo "=== Keycloak login page (should use startuphafen theme) ==="
curl -s "http://localhost:28080/realms/startuphafen/protocol/openid-connect/auth?client_id=startuphafen_app&response_type=code" | grep -oiE "startuphafen|<title>[^<]*</title>" | head -5
echo "=== Frontend styles asset via caddy ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "  GET /styles.css -> %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:4000/styles.css
echo "=== pgadmin up ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "  GET :3838 -> %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3838/
echo "=== final container health ==="
docker compose -f .devcontainer/dev-fixed.yml ps --format "{{.Name}}: {{.Status}}" | sort
